raw_text:
PLAN "12-week Upper Body Rehab & Strength for Climber"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Restore pain-free shoulder function and progressive upper-body strength for climbing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Intro / Pain-free Control" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Scapular control & horizontal strength":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Scapular wall slides" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          "Prone Y (on bench) - pain-free ROM" 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          "Seated row (light) - neutral grip" 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Incline push-up (hands elevated) - pain-free" 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded external rotation (elbow at side)" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Thoracic mobility & posterior chain":
        warmup:
          treadmill walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Quadruped thoracic rotations" 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          "Dumbbell prone row (light) - pain-free" 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Face pulls (band or cable) - high to eyes" 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          "Single-arm supported lat pulldown (neutral) - light" 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded pull-aparts" 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          sleeper stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Endurance & rotator cuff resilience":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "EZ-bar horizontal rows (light) - pain-free" 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Isometric shoulder abduction hold (side, pain-free)  - 30s" 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          "Banded internal rotation (elbow at side)" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          "Farmer carry (light)  - neutral shoulder" 3x40m rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Incline face pulls" 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular retraction hold 3m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Scapular & horizontal control":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Scapular wall slides" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          "Prone Y (on bench) - pain-free ROM" 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          "Seated row (moderate) - neutral grip" 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Incline push-up (lower angle if pain-free)" 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded external rotation (elbow at side)" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Mobility & posterior chain":
        warmup:
          treadmill walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Quadruped thoracic rotations" 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          "Dumbbell prone row (moderate) - pain-free" 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Face pulls (band or cable) - high to eyes" 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          "Single-arm supported lat pulldown (neutral)" 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded pull-aparts" 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          sleeper stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Endurance & resilience":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "EZ-bar horizontal rows (moderate)" 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Isometric shoulder abduction hold (side)  - 35s" 3x35s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          "Banded internal rotation (elbow at side)" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          "Farmer carry (moderate)  - neutral shoulder" 3x50m rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Incline face pulls" 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular retraction hold 3m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Progression - horizontal strength":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Scapular wall slides" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          "Prone Y (on bench) - pain-free ROM" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          "Chest-supported row (dumbbell) - moderate" 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Incline push-up (lower angle)  - pain-free" 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded external rotation (elbow at side)" 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Thoracic & scapular stability":
        warmup:
          treadmill walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Quadruped thoracic rotations" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          "One-arm dumbbell row (supporting arm on bench) - light" 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Face pulls (cable) - moderate" 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          "Neutral-grip lat pulldown - controlled" 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded pull-aparts" 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          sleeper stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Endurance & carry":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Seated cable row (neutral) - controlled" 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Isometric shoulder abduction hold (side)  - 40s" 3x40s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          "Banded internal rotation (elbow at side)" 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          "Farmer carry (moderate)  - 2 sets 40m" 2x40m rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          "Incline face pulls" 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular retraction hold 3m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Load tolerance increase (still no overhead)":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Scapular wall slides" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          "Prone Y (on bench) - pain-free ROM" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          "Chest-supported row (dumbbell) - moderate" 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Incline dumbbell press (light, ≤ shoulder height) - pain-free" 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded external rotation (elbow at side)" 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Strength & control":
        warmup:
          treadmill walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Quadruped thoracic rotations" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          "One-arm dumbbell row (moderate)" 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Face pulls (cable) - moderate" 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Neutral-grip lat pulldown - moderate" 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded pull-aparts" 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          sleeper stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Endurance & functional carry":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Seated cable row (neutral) - moderate" 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Isometric shoulder abduction hold (side)  - 45s" 3x45s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Banded internal rotation (elbow at side)" 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          "Farmer carry (challenging)  - 2x50m" 2x50m rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Incline face pulls" 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular retraction hold 3m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Load Introduction & Progressive Strength" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Horizontal & pulling strength":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Chest-supported row (heavier)" 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Incline dumbbell press (kept below overhead) - moderate" 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Single-arm cable row (neutral) - controlled" 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Face pulls (heavy band/cable)" 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 4m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Scapular & thoracic":
        warmup:
          treadmill walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Quadruped thoracic rotations" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          "Standing banded external rotation (45° abduction) - pain-free" 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          "Lat pulldown (neutral) - progressive" 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Rear delt dumbbell fly (incline bench)" 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Banded pull-aparts" 3x20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          sleeper stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Load tolerance & carries":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Seated cable row - heavier" 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Incline push (dumbbell) - controlled" 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Farmers carry (heavy) - neutral" 4x40m rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded internal rotation (standing)" 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular retraction hold 3m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Strength focus - pulling":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Chest-supported row (heavier)" 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Single-arm dumbbell row (heavier)" 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Neutral-grip lat pulldown - heavier" 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Face pulls (heavy) - controlled" 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 4m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Scapular control & rotator cuff":
        warmup:
          treadmill walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Quadruped thoracic rotations" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          "Standing banded external rotation (45° abduction)" 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          "Single-arm cable row (progressive)" 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Rear delt dumbbell fly (moderate)" 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Banded pull-aparts" 3x20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          sleeper stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Strength & conditioning":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Seated cable row - heavy" 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Incline dumbbell press (moderate-heavy)" 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Farmer carry (heavy) - timed sets 45m" 3x45m rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded internal rotation (standing)" 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular retraction hold 3m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Pull strength & volume":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Chest-supported row - heavy" 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "One-arm dumbbell row - heavy" 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Neutral-grip lat pulldown - heavy" 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Face pulls (heavy)" 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 4m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Rotator cuff capacity":
        warmup:
          treadmill walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Quadruped thoracic rotations" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          "Standing banded external rotation (45° abduction)" 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Banded pull-aparts" 4x20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          "Rear delt dumbbell fly (moderate-heavy)" 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Isometric shoulder abduction hold (side)  - 45s" 3x45s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          sleeper stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Strength & carries":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Seated cable row - heavy" 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Incline dumbbell press (moderate-heavy)" 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Farmer carry (heavy)  - 3x50m" 3x50m rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded internal rotation (standing)" 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular retraction hold 3m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Peak strength session (no overhead)":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Chest-supported row - heavy" 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          "One-arm dumbbell row - heavy" 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Neutral-grip lat pulldown - heavy" 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Face pulls (heavy)" 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 4m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Rotator cuff & mobility":
        warmup:
          treadmill walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Quadruped thoracic rotations" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          "Standing banded external rotation (45° abduction)" 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Banded pull-aparts" 4x20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          "Rear delt dumbbell fly (moderate-heavy)" 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          sleeper stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Endurance strength & carries":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Seated cable row - heavy" 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          "Incline dumbbell press (heavy but pain-free)" 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Farmer carry (heavy)  - 3x60m" 3x60m rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded internal rotation (standing)" 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular retraction hold 3m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Climbing-specific Strength & Return to Load" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Max horizontal & pulling strength":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Chest-supported row - 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds"
          "One-arm dumbbell row - 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds"
          "Neutral-grip lat pulldown - 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds"
          "Face pulls (heavy)" 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 4m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Isometric holds & rotator cuff capacity":
        warmup:
          treadmill walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Quadruped thoracic rotations" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          "Isometric scapular pull-up hold (feet supported) - pain-free 15s" 4x15s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Standing banded external rotation (45° abduction)" 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Banded pull-aparts" 4x20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          sleeper stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Climbing-specific pulling & carries":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Seated cable row - 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
" 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Incline dumbbell press (heavy but pain-free)" 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Farmer carry (heavy)  - 3x60m" 3x60m rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded internal rotation (standing)" 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular retraction hold 3m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Maintain strength & endurance":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Chest-supported row - 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
" 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "One-arm dumbbell row - 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
" 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Neutral-grip lat pulldown - 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds"
          "Face pulls (heavy)" 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 4m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Isometric & rotator cuff mix":
        warmup:
          treadmill walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Quadruped thoracic rotations" 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          "Isometric scapular pull-up hold (feet supported) - 20s" 4x20s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Standing banded external rotation (45° abduction)" 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Banded pull-aparts" 4x20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          sleeper stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Return-to-climb prep (no overhead)":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Seated cable row - 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds"
          "Incline dumbbell press (heavy but pain-free)" 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Farmer carry (heavy) - 3x60m" 3x60m rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded internal rotation (standing)" 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular retraction hold 3m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Power & strength maintenance":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Chest-supported row - 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds"
          "One-arm dumbbell row - 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds"
          "Neutral-grip lat pulldown - 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds"
          "Face pulls (heavy)" 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 4m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Climbing-specific holds (pain-free)":
        warmup:
          treadmill walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Isometric scapular pull-up hold (feet supported) - 25s" 4x25s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Standing banded external rotation (45° abduction)" 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Banded pull-aparts" 4x20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          "Dead hang (assisted/pain-free) - 2x20s" 2x20s rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          sleeper stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Prep for return to climbing load":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Seated cable row - 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds"
          "Incline dumbbell press (heavy but pain-free)" 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Farmer carry (heavy) - 3x60m" 3x60m rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          "Banded internal rotation (standing)" 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular retraction hold 3m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Assessment & deload-to-return":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Chest-supported row - 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
" 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "One-arm dumbbell row - 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds"
          "Neutral-grip lat pulldown - 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds"
          "Face pulls (moderate)" 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec doorway stretch 4m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Final rotator cuff & isometrics":
        warmup:
          treadmill walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Isometric scapular pull-up hold (feet supported) - 30s" 4x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Standing banded external rotation (45° abduction)" 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Banded pull-aparts" 4x20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          "Dead hang (assisted/pain-free) - 2x25s" 2x25s rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          sleeper stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Graduated return to climbing session (gym)":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          "Seated cable row - 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds"
          "Incline dumbbell press (moderate) - 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds"
          "Dead hang (assisted/pain-free) - 3x20s" 3x20s rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          "Isometric scapular pull-up hold (feet supported) - 3x20s" 3x20s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          "Banded external rotation (elbow at side)" 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular retraction hold 3m
